name: Minnesota House High School Page Program
org: Minnesota House of Representatives, Sergeant at Arms Office
what_you_do: Spend one week at the State Capitol. You page on the House floor, sit in a mock committee meeting, and meet legislators, judges, lobbyists and reporters.
who_can_apply: Any Minnesota high school junior. You can go to a public or private school or be home schooled. Selection is competitive. The program tries to include students from all parts of the state.
pay_detail: Small meal stipend. The program pays for the hotel. You pay your other personal costs.
duration: One week (Monday to Friday) in Saint Paul. 2027 weeks run from Jan 25 to May 14, 2027.
deadline_text: Complete applications are due by end of business on Nov 10, 2026 for the 2027 session. Selected students are told by email by mid-December.
how_to_apply: Download the 2027 Page Application PDF from the House Sergeant at Arms site. Email it to EducationalPrograms@house.mn.gov. You also need a 500-word essay. You need one letter of recommendation. It can come from a teacher, counselor or academic advisor.
notes: Participants stay together as a group each evening at the program-designated hotel. Questions: Sergeant at Arms office, 651-296-4860.
